technical_quality: Adequate. PA erect film with L side marker on image right (conventional orientation confirmed). Apices and both costophrenic angles included; inferior corners partly obscured by external curved radiopaque artifacts.

abnormalities.finding: Coarse reticular / peribronchovascular hazy opacity (infiltrate) in the infrahilar and medial basal lung, asymmetric compared with the left, approx 6-8 cm; no air bronchogram or consolidation-level density; no effusion
Tortuous / unfolded thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob, consistent with age-related change; heart size within normal limits
Tiny dense nodular dot (~3-4 mm) in the lower zone, most likely an end-on vessel or small calcified granuloma; indeterminate

description_zh: PA 胸部X光，吸氣深度與穿透度尚可，無明顯旋轉，影像右上方可見 L 側位標記。右側下肺野（肺門下方至內側基底部）可見粗糙網狀及支氣管血管束周圍增加之浸潤性陰影，範圍約 6–8 公分，左肺野相對清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利，未見氣胸或肋膜積液。心臟大小正常，胸主動脈迂曲並主動脈弓突出，符合高齡變化。右上腹於片緣可見數枚小金屬密度影（疑為手術夾），兩側下角另有弧形外來高密度偽影（疑為鉛衣或擺位裝置），未見胸管或引流管。
